purpose: Full connected redraw; horizontal sword pose exposes both straight cutting edges for inspection.
prompt:
Draw a NEW COMPLETE battle pose of the approved knight in image 1. Image 2 clarifies his exact helmet. The head, neck, shoulder, arm, gripping hand and sword must be drawn together as one continuous character, no separate parts or pasted helmet.

Single full-body figure, transparent background, 1536x1024 landscape. Place the entire armored body in the left half. Same approved blue/silver/gold armor, original compact silver face mask and blue jewel helmet (no extra rear horns), same long blue/black/gold cape, natural adult proportions. Both feet planted wide, knees slightly bent, three-quarter front-right view, torso in horizontal sword-slash follow-through. Right arm extended toward the right at lower chest height; left hand counterbalances. Head faces right but face remains visible in the original three-quarter angle.

MOST IMPORTANT: draw the full original BROAD ivory and ornate gold GREATSWORD PERFECTLY HORIZONTAL. Pommel, black handle, round gold sunburst guard, straight gold central spine and blade tip all on ONE horizontal straight line. Both long cutting edges are STRAIGHT and nearly parallel, tapering only slightly toward a short sharp triangular tip. Show the flat broad sword face to the camera. No foreshortened edge-on rapier, no curved scimitar, no banana bend, no wavy edges, no angular break at the guard. Hand and wrist grip this horizontal handle naturally. Keep original substantial blade width and detailed gold ornament on its flat surface, original length proportional to body. The sword points to the RIGHT and its point is completely inside the frame with generous margin. Full cape, head and boots also have at least 6% clear margins. Do not reuse the previous bent sword. No glow, no aura, no effects, no floor, no UI, no labels, no logos. True transparent cutout. High detail painted game asset consistent with original.
